note: Actual export shipments are confirmed by dated Indian customs/bill-of-lading records: four export B/Ls in Jan–Feb 2026 to the United States (Dallas, Norfolk x2) and Spain (Barcelona), all under HS 83021010 (hinges with mountings of base metal) — not the declared HS 731814 (self-tapping screws). Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual 83021010 (hinges), verdict accepted_hs_corrected. The import row of semi-finished ball-bearing hinges from Foshan Yanman (China) explicitly marked "FOR CAPTIVE USE EXPORT PURPOSE" indicates a trader/manufacturer_trader model (import of components + re-export of finished hinges), so role is best recorded as manufacturer_trader rather than pure manufacturer. Domestic Indian supply activity is unverified — no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender or contract evidence was obtainable, so it is marked unknown, not confirmed and not denied.
